groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops: liquids, floods and what they carry.

chars.story: Water that has sat so long it turns thick: mud.
chars.note: Wet earth, clay.

chars.story: All the water rising together at once: a flood.
chars.note: Also 'great' in a few formal words.

chars.story: Clear white water bubbling up from the ground.
chars.note: The water source, not the season.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 炎 double fire
chars.story: Water poured in until the flame-colour fades: diluted.
chars.note: Also 'light in colour' and 'indifferent'.

chars.story: Water with good things cooked in it: soup.
chars.note: 湯 became 汤; the right side was simplified.

chars.story: Water stirred so full of things it is thick: concentrated.
chars.note: 濃 became 浓; works for smells, colours and liquids.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 尸 roof + 雨 rain
chars.story: Rain coming through a roof, with water dripping: a leak.
chars.note: 漏洞 'hole' is also a 'loophole' in an argument.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Three strokes on the left: a hand at work.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 并 side by side
chars.story: Hands set the pieces side by side: piece together.
chars.note: 拼命 'go all out' is the common word.

chars.story: A hand closes the opening: fasten a button.
chars.note: Also 'to deduct'. 釦 is an old form for 'button'.

chars.story: A hand lets money go to others: donate.
chars.note: Also a 'tax' in old words.

chars.story: A hand strikes a bell and it vibrates.
chars.note: Also 'to rouse'.

chars.story: Hands sorting clothes to play a part: dress up.
chars.note: Also 'to put on an expression'.

chars.story: A hand props the roof up with a pole.
chars.note: 撐 became 撑 with a simpler right side.

chars.story: A body laid open by the butcher: slaughter.
chars.note: Killing animals for food, or killing people in great numbers.

chars.story: A knife that does harm: it cuts apart.
chars.note: Also 'to cut off' and 'to part with'.

chars.story: A knife trimming a book: delete.
chars.note: 刪 became 删; 册 stayed.

chars.story: A knife working the skin off: peel.
chars.note: Also 'to strip rights'.

chars.story: Hands pull a building apart: tear down.
chars.note: 拆迁 is demolition for redevelopment.

chars.parts: 车 cart + 车 cart + 车 cart
chars.story: Three carts crash together: a loud boom.
chars.note: 轟 had three 車; 轰 keeps three simplified 车.

chars.story: What is left under the cover after a fire: ash.
chars.note: Also 'gray' and 'dust'.

chars.story: Fire burns the impurities out of metal: refine.
chars.note: 煉 had 柬; 炼 uses 东. 锻炼 is 'to exercise'.

chars.story: Fire cooks it soft until it falls apart: rotten.
chars.note: Also 'soft and falling apart'.

chars.story: The black rock you burn: coal.
chars.note: 煤气 'gas' is the cooking fuel.

chars.story: The heart gripped by what it holds: fear.
chars.note: His Analects card 懼 is 'fear'. The complicated right side 瞿 became 具.

chars.story: A heart swelling till it bursts out: indignant.
chars.note: His Analects card 憤 is 'burst with effort'. The right side 賁 became 贲.

chars.story: Pain put on the heart so it learns: punish.
chars.note: 懲 had 徵; 惩 uses 征.

chars.story: A heart swept clean of clutter: intelligent.
chars.note: Mostly seen in 智慧 'wisdom'.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person standing: roles and copies.

chars.story: A person copying a model exactly: imitate.
chars.note: 仿佛 'as if' is very common.

chars.story: A person living up on the mountain, beyond death: immortal.
chars.note: A Daoist who has become deathless.

chars.story: Two people: how a person treats another.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card. Modern use is mostly 仁慈 'kind'; 仁 also means the 'kernel' of a nut.

chars.story: A person with a blank, slack look: foolish.
chars.note: Colloquial; the right side is not worth analysing.

chars.story: A tall wooden thing you set things on: a table.
chars.note: A flat table top.

chars.story: A tree whose fruit is round and pink: peach.
chars.note: 樱桃 'cherry' uses it as well.

chars.story: A tree planted in the ground to bar the way: stamp out.
chars.note: Also a surname Du and an old pear tree.

groups.title: earth 土
groups.note: Soil and what is made from it.

chars.story: Earth heaped up into a pile.
chars.note: Also the counter for 'a heap of'.

chars.story: Clay worked by hand into a shape: mold.
chars.note: 塑料 'plastic' is the common word.

groups.title: half of a pair
groups.note: Characters that live almost only in one two-character word.

chars.story: A mouth tastes the dark drink: coffee.
chars.note: Only appears in 咖啡 'coffee', after 咖.

chars.story: A grassy vine heavy with fruit: grape.
chars.note: Only appears in 葡萄 'grape', after 葡.

chars.story: Earth with something piled upright: trash.
chars.note: Only appears in 垃圾 'trash', before 圾.

chars.story: Earth where unwanted things end up: garbage.
chars.note: Only appears in 垃圾 'trash', after 垃.

groups.title: road and steps
groups.note: A foot on the road: walking, long and short.

chars.story: A foot at the branch of a path: the ways divide.
chars.note: 歧视 'discrimination' is the common word.

chars.parts: 辶 walk + 万 ten thousand
chars.story: A long step down the road: stride.
chars.note: Also 'elderly' in 年迈. 邁 became 迈.

chars.story: A road you walk on and on: distant.
chars.note: 遥控 is 'remote control'.

groups.title: shell 贝
groups.note: Shells, once money: wealth and payment.

chars.story: Wanting the money right now: greedy.
chars.note: 貪 became 贪 with the simple 贝.

chars.story: Money and arms given over as dues: endow.
chars.note: Also 'tax' and a kind of poem.

chars.story: Paying shells for the damage: compensate.
chars.note: 賠 became 赔 with the simple 贝.

groups.title: town 阝
groups.note: A mound or city on the right: surnames and places.

chars.story: A hand in the town: the surname Deng.
chars.note: A surname. 鄧 became 邓.

chars.story: A walled town: the surname Zheng.
chars.note: A surname and place name (Zhengzhou); in 郑重 'solemn'.

chars.story: A good lad of the town: a young man.
chars.note: 新郎 'groom' is the common word.

chars.story: A fang hidden in the town: crooked, not upright.
chars.note: Evil or unhealthy forces.

chars.story: A mouth speaking to the sky: Wu.
chars.note: A surname and an ancient state around Shanghai. 吳 became 吴.

chars.story: A walker marked out: the surname Zhao.
chars.note: A surname and an ancient state. 趙 became 赵.

chars.parts: - a tiger-like rim over a stand
chars.story: A big rim over a dish: the surname Lu.
chars.note: A surname; in loanwords like 卢布 'ruble'. 盧 became 卢.

chars.story: A gap between mounds: Shaanxi province.
chars.note: A place-name character; short name for Shaanxi. 陝 became 陕.

chars.story: A road that goes on to the horizon: faraway.
chars.note: Also a province name (Liaoning) and a dynasty.

chars.story: A roof with someone rooted under it: a residence.
chars.note: Also 'stay at home': 宅.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 亻 person + 百 hundred
chars.story: A person sleeps under a roof: lodge.
chars.note: Also an old word for a star group.

chars.story: A cow kept under a roof: a pen, a jail.
chars.note: Also 'firm'.

chars.story: A tree under a roof: the Song dynasty.
chars.note: Also a surname.

chars.story: A hand with strength behind it: energy.
chars.note: 勁 had a more complex left side. Also 'attitude', as in 没劲.

chars.story: Putting strength into the work every day: diligent.
chars.note: Also 'regularly'.

chars.story: A man standing straight on a bed: robust.
chars.note: 壯 became 壮; the left side is 丬.

chars.story: A wide-open grin hiding a lie: cheat.
chars.note: 欺负 'bully' is very common.

chars.story: A hand scraping the field with a clam shell: low work, disgrace.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card; modern 侮辱 'insult'.

chars.story: Half of you turns against your side: betray.
chars.note: A traitor or rebel.

chars.story: A cross marked in a pit: a bad sign.
chars.note: Also 'ominous'.

chars.parts: - a bent hand with a bar through it
chars.story: A bent, clawing hand: ugly or clownish.
chars.note: 醜 'ugly' merged into 丑, which was the clown and the 2nd earthly branch.

chars.story: Words that make a thing look excellent: entice.
chars.note: 誘 became 诱 with 讠 on the left.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: A woman: family ties and fine things.

chars.story: A woman with her reason for joining a new house: marriage.
chars.note: Only appears in 婚姻 'marriage'.

chars.story: The finest, lightest touch of a woman's hand: wonderful.
chars.note: 莫名其妙 'baffling' is a common phrase.

chars.parts: 厸 arrow shapes + 日 sun
chars.story: Climbing up into the sunlight: advance.
chars.note: 晉 became 晋. Also the short name of Shanxi.

chars.story: Two suns stacked: bright and thriving.
chars.note: Also a surname.

chars.story: Looking up at a mountain of ancestors: esteem.
chars.note: Respect that looks up.

chars.story: A flag on a pole: a commander, a handsome figure.
chars.note: 帥 had a different left; modern 帅 is a pole and cloth.

chars.parts: - a long pole with a blade at the tip
chars.story: A long pole with a blade at the tip: a spear.
chars.note: 矛盾 pairs spear and shield.

chars.story: A bamboo shaft that flies forward: an arrow.
chars.note: A rocket is a 'fire arrow'.

chars.story: Small on top, big at the bottom: a point.
chars.note: Also 'sharp' of a mind, or 'top' as in 顶尖.

chars.story: Hemp ground on a stone: grind.
chars.note: Also 'to polish'.

chars.story: A plow worn thin as hair: consume.
chars.note: Also 'to waste time'.

chars.story: A hand pulling a beard, and he bears it: endure.
chars.note: 耐心 'patience' is the common word.

chars.story: A guard stands on the ridge: a sentry post.
chars.note: 崗 became 岗. Also a hillock.

chars.story: A long walk through a palace courtyard: the court.
chars.note: Old word for the emperor's court.

chars.story: An ear open to an offer: engage.
chars.note: 招聘 and 应聘 are job-hunting words.

chars.story: Leather you stand on: a shoe.
chars.note: A shoe, any kind.

chars.story: Two rows of strings over a body: a zither.
chars.note: Any stringed instrument; 钢琴 is 'steel zither'.

chars.story: Silk woven with metal threads: brocade.
chars.note: Seen mostly in 锦标赛 'championship'.

chars.story: A sticky stuff boiled from flesh that joins things: glue.
chars.note: Also 'rubber' and 'gel'.

chars.story: Sweetness on the tongue: sweet.
chars.note: 甘 is the part meaning 'sweet'.

chars.story: Food missing from the one who needs it: hungry.
chars.note: 餓 became 饿; 饣 is the simplified food sign.

chars.parts: - a melon hanging from a curling vine
chars.story: A melon hanging from a curling vine.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card. Modern words: 西瓜, 南瓜, and 傻瓜 'fool'.

chars.story: Rice with big grains piled together: coarse.
chars.note: 麤 was three deer; 粗 is simple.

chars.story: The wet dregs left after pressing grain: messy.
chars.note: 糟糕 'too bad' is the key word.

chars.parts: - a sheep seen from the front, horns on top
chars.story: A sheep's face with two horns curling over it.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card; modern 羊 also covers 'goat'.

chars.story: A beast chases its prey, and a man follows: hunt.
chars.note: 獵 became 猎.

chars.parts: 大 + 冖 cover + 牛 cow
chars.story: A cow led along on a rope: lead along.
chars.note: 牽 had a different top; the cow 牛 is still there.

chars.story: Feathers spread out on both sides: wing.
chars.note: 小心翼翼 'very carefully' is a common phrase.

chars.story: A small amount of grain: slightly.
chars.note: Always followed by a verb of change.

chars.parts: - a paw print above a field
chars.story: A paw print in a field: foreign, a beast.
chars.note: Also counts 'times' and 'kinds'; 番茄 is 'foreign eggplant'.

chars.story: A mouth put forward next to ask advice: consult.
chars.note: Appears only in 咨询 'consult'.

chars.story: A mouth puffing out a jet: spray.
chars.note: 噴 became 喷; the right side was simplified.

sentences.en: He even called you an idiot.
Why do you like coffee strong?
The trash is really starting to pile up.
My patience is nearing its limit.

sentences.zh: 他很勤奋但不是很有天赋。
sentences.en: He is not so much a genius as a hard worker.

sentences.zh: 无知是恐惧之母，也是崇拜之母。
sentences.en: Ignorance is the mother of fear as well as of admiration.

sentences.zh: 他承认自己与这宗丑闻有牵连。
sentences.en: He admits being involved in the scandal.

sentences.zh: 我才感冒一天没来上班，桌上就堆满了文件。
sentences.en: I only missed one day of work because of a cold and my desk is piled high with papers.
